Keep sound on this phone while muting the computer’s speakers and headphones. Their previous mute settings return when you leave this screen or the connection ends. Volume and microphone settings stay as they are. Adjusting mute on the computer ends this setting.

Cover the computer’s displays during this session. On the computer, press Ctrl + Alt + Shift + P to restore them. Locking, display changes, leaving this screen, or connection problems end privacy mode. Only one remote session can use it.

You can also lock the computer when this remote session ends. This applies to this session only. Brief network interruptions do not trigger locking.
This computer will lock after this remote session ends. A new remote session, a local lock or unlock, or an unconfirmed computer state cancels this setting.
